description:
Title: Android RIL/Modem Development Engineer 
 Locations: Mountain View, CA
 Duration: 12 months 
 

 Role and Responsibility 
 • Design, documentation and implementation of RIL, modem software features for US wireless carriers (VZW, Sprint) as per the carrier requirement and industry standard/specification.
 • Collaboration with verification engineers in defining / designing software verification test cases and plans and following up on test results to close the issues.
 • Effective and efficient communication, knowledge sharing and status reporting to stake holders, project and line management in both verbal and written form such as e-mail, documentation, and wiki..
 

 Experience Required
 • Minimum 7 years of software design and development experience in mobile embedded systems and products required. 

 • Minimum 5 years of software design and development experience in RIL/Modem subsystem.
 • CDMA + LTE experience for NA operators ( Verizon Wireless or Sprint )
 • Excellent knowledge of programming languages – C/C++, Java and 3GPP, 3GPP2 standards
 • Strong Industry Experience with RIL Development Background
 • Deep understanding of Android architecture.
 • Strong communication, coordination, organization, and reporting skills.
 • Experienced with Smartphone and Tablets
 • Experience developing project proposals and working with customers
 


 • Minimum BS degree in electrical engineering, computer software engineering, or a related discipline required MS degree is a plus.

 
 If you are comfortable with the above job description & the Qualifications...
 Share you updated resume with your basic contact information...
 So that we can discuss about the position more...
 

 Thanks & Regards,
 Sandeep
 TEkWISSEN LLC

 734-418-0079
